modalities.evidence: motion data from two IMU sensors

output.population: 7 healthy adults (4 male, 3 female), ages 20–30 years; mean = 24.3, SD = 3.8
output.summary: Longitudinal brain-machine interface study in which healthy adults used motor imagery to control a lower-limb exoskeleton, recording EEG, EOG, IMU motion and exoskeleton control signals across nine sessions per participant.
